subject: Cannot connect to VPN
body: My VPN says authentication failed, but I can sign in to Microsoft 365 normally.

subject: Suspicious Microsoft login email
body: I received an unexpected email asking me to sign in to Microsoft 365 using a link. I have not clicked the link.

subject: Office printer offline
body: The accounting printer shows as offline on my Windows computer. Other employees are able to print.

subject: Laptop running very slowly
body: My Windows laptop has been extremely slow since this morning. Programs are taking several minutes to open.

subject: Account locked
body: I entered my password incorrectly several times and now my company account says it is locked.
